title: Cable Crunch
summary: Kneeling cable crunch: curl the ribs toward the pelvis against a rope. Abs 1, obliques 0.4. Loadable in small steps.

equipment_needs.text: Needs: cable station with an adjustable pulley.

muscles.why: The rectus abdominis flexes the spine. The work happens when the spine rounds, not when the hips bend.
The obliques help flex the spine (0.4).

setup.text: Rope on a high pulley; kneel facing it.
Hold the rope by your head or forehead.
Hips stay still above the knees.

form_cues.why: Rounding the spine is the ab work.

form_cues.cue: Crunch your ribs toward your pelvis
form_cues.why: Hips staying still stops it becoming a hip hinge.
Controlling the return lets the abs lengthen under load.
Many lifters find it easier to round on the exhale.

bias_tweaks.change: Crunch toward one knee, then the other
bias_tweaks.effect: Adds rotation, so the obliques work more.

bias_tweaks.change: Lower in 2-3 seconds and pause briefly in the stretch
bias_tweaks.effect: Keeps tension on in the lengthened position and removes bounce, so each rep starts honestly.
bias_tweaks.caveat: Rep speeds from 0.5 to 8 s gave similar growth; this is a control tool, not a growth trick.

mistakes.text: Sitting back on the heels to pull with the hips.
mistakes.fix: Lighten the load until the hips stay still.

mistakes.text: Sitting back with the hips instead of rounding.
mistakes.fix: Keep the hips above the knees.
The hands stay fixed by your head.

misconceptions.reality: Training a muscle doesn't selectively reduce the fat over it.
Abs respond to the same hard sets as other muscles; loading lets you train them in normal rep ranges.

lower_risk.text: The app adds no ramp-up sets here. If the muscle is not warm from earlier work, make the first set a little lighter.

Add load in small steps. The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 10% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first, up to 2 past the top of the range. Default steps for this equipment are 2.5 kg or 5 lb; your gym profile can replace them.
Aim for about 2 reps in reserve in the 10-15 rep range. Low-risk to push close to failure.
Pick a variation, range and setup you can train pain-free.

alternatives.goal_label: Home gym: no equipment / bar only
alternatives.why: Bar only; curl the hips up.

alternatives.goal_label: Home gym: no equipment / bar only
alternatives.why: Decline bench crunch, holding a plate.

notes: Ab exercises have not been compared for growth in a study the app cites.
Ratings and display bands are the library model (main >= 0.75, helper 0.4 to < 0.75, minor 0.25 to < 0.4, not counted < 0.25).
Technique and load management only. This page makes no medical or injury claims.
